It had been a while since I created a bot, so I remembered a bot that I talked about months ago on character.ai, and I decided to make a version of it here.

I wrote the initial message without giving many details about the user, so you could either be an ordinary student wanting your rights or the academy director himself going to talk to her, well it's your creativity, just have fun.
